content.comment_body: Hello, quick question: Do you want to upgrade [product_name]? Here's a resource: Firmware update for [product_name] devices and service pack for [product_name] [version_no]. [url] Best regards, [user_name]
I checked the link and it worked for me. Possibly it was a temporary issue.

I agree with @[user_name] that the link functions properly. However, I've previously seen link issues with the newer forum interface. It generally works if you're using the older forum layout. If you encounter a problem like this, you can copy the text from the web link and enter it into the search feature, changing the search option from 'Forum' to 'Knowledge base' for better results. Alternatively, you can use the link's ending identity number '[article_no]' to search as well. Tested on the new forum interface, and in my opinion, 'Knowledge base' should be the default. This feature is helpful, unless it gets changed again.

At work, I get an error: 'Welcome to [company_name] Industry Automation and Drive Technologies. Unfortunately, the page you requested is temporarily unavailable. You may find useful information on the homepage. Thank you for understanding.' However, at home, the link works fine.

analysis.insight_summary: The main concern among users was difficulty accessing the upgrade link for [product_name], which occasionally resulted in an error message about page unavailability. This accessibility issue was inconsistent, as the link failed in one location but functioned elsewhere. Differences in the forum interface also impacted access, and users shared advice on alternative search methods and navigation tips.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect stable and consistent access to upgrade resources for [product_name], irrespective of their location or the forum interface used. Reliable access to official updates and related information is important for a seamless experience.
